Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking the time on the call intro last week. BrightLayer’s infra team would like a technical deep-dive focused on dedicated GPU pools: sizing guidance, autoscaling behavior under bursty inference, and isolation strategies for multi-tenant workloads.

Goals for the session:
- Confirm expected throughput and latency targets for our 150 req/s peak patterns
- Understand isolation guarantees: tenant-level KV cache, noisy neighbor mitigation, network segmentation
- Walk through autoscale policies, cold-start behavior, and how to configure burst capacity

Proposed attendees: myself (Eleanor), Rajiv Menon (infra lead), + procurement (for later procurement steps). We can make time on either:
- Thu Jul 16, 10:00–11:00 PDT
- Thu Jul 16, 14:00–15:00 PDT
- Fri Jul 17, 09:00–10:00 PDT

Attached is our RFP excerpt that highlights expected SLAs and data isolation needs (BrightLayer_RFP.pdf). Let me know which slot works and whether you want any additional pre-read from our side.

Thanks,
Eleanor Park
Head of Infrastructure
BrightLayer Systems
